details: Windows 10, NewChirp 1.0.23, serial COM4. 12 CR/ID probe rounds; ID gets a reply but the driver rejects it. A second report shows 'FormatException: Missing extension byte', the non-UTF-8 radio reply crashing 1.0.23's output decoding (current releases decode with allowMalformed). Needs an update to the current release and a fresh report showing the radio's ID reply.
summary: Read fails: ID handshake answered but 'Unexpected response from radio' (1.0.23)
